rules.warning: Selections of shop { draftOrders } move to the root draftOrders connection with the same arguments; Shopify removed the Shop connection in 2026-01.
rules.quote: please update your applications to use the [`QueryRoot.draftOrders`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/objects/QueryRoot#field-QueryRoot.fields.draftOrders) object for retrieving multiple draft orders.

rules.warning: Selections of Shop.billingAddress become Shop.shopAddress, which Shopify says has the same structure and values; billingAddress is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.
rules.quote: This new field replaces the now-deprecated `billingAddress` field, which will be removed in a future version. `shopAddress` will have identical structure and values as `billingAddress`.
